verdict.rationale: Docs describe a web-based task board for running many agents in parallel with per-card worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains, plus subagents for parallel research and CLI cron scheduling for headless/long-running automation — directly matching the 'fleet of autonomous agents' story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the Kanban fleet feature specifically, and explicit evidence of multi-day continuous runs rather than just scheduled/headless execution.
